methodology.bleu_type: 语料库级BLEU（corpus-level），先聚合所有样本n-gram计数再统一计算，避免单句零匹配问题
methodology.tokenization: 中文使用jieba精确模式分词；字符级BLEU将每个字符视为一个token，对中英混合场景更鲁棒
methodology.rouge_l: 基于最长公共子序列（LCS）计算召回率、精确率和F1，捕捉生成文本与参考答案的语义重叠度
methodology.limitations: 开放式对话中，同一上下文存在多种合理回复，BLEU/ROUGE仅衡量与特定参考答案的表面匹配度，无法评估回复的创意性、情感恰当性或角色一致性。因此这些指标应与其他评估维度（如MBTI准确率）配合使用。

[I should elaborate.] It isn't serious yet, but it's getting there fast.
details.generated: [nods gravely, lowering his voice] I'm afraid it's unavoidable under the circumstances. The quarantine, the communication restrictions—people are bound to speculate. And when they can't get answers, morale inevitably suffers. I'd like to address the senior staff after our meeting, with your permission.

details.reference: [I think I know what he's referring to.] The news blackout.
[He's perceptive.] Right. My people are getting very steamed up about it. After all, most of them have families back on Earth; they probably believe they're all dead of moon-plague.
details.generated: Right. That's created a certain amount of strain.

details.reference: [I understand the necessity, but it's causing problems.] I'm sorry about that, but no one could think of a better cover story, and so far it's worked. By the way - I met Moisewitch at the Space Station, and even he bought it.
details.generated: (sighing heavily) That's... quite an imagination. I can assure you, we're doing everything we can.

details.reference: The room falls silent as the scientists listen intently to Floyd's words.
details.generated: Floyd's words hang in the air, met with a low murmur of approval and a few exchanged glances of cautious relief. The dim lighting barely reveals the subtle nodding of heads, but tension still coils beneath the surface—everyone senses there is more to be said, and the massive screen behind the podium flickers once, as if alive.

details.reference: [I need to acknowledge their frustration.] I'm quite aware that some of you - perhaps most of you - are anxious that the present veil of secrecy be withdrawn; you would not be scientists if you thought otherwise.
[I agree, but I'm frustrated by the secrecy.] (frowning slightly)

[I must emphasize the importance of caution.] But I would remind you that this is a quite extraordinary situation. We must be absolutely sure of our own facts; if we make errors now there may be no second chance - so please be patient a little longer. Those are also the wishes of the President.
details.generated: I understand your frustration, Doctor

details.reference: Floyd returns to his seat as the lights dim and Dr. Michaels approaches the podium.
details.generated: The low hum of the base's life-support systems suddenly seems louder in the weighted silence that follows Floyd's words, a few scientists exchanging uneasy glances while security personnel remain motionless at the chamber's perimeter.

details.reference: [I'm excited to finally present our findings.] (displaying an image of the Moon) On this vertical photograph, Tycho is even more conspicuous than when seen from Earth; then it's rather near the edge of the Moon. But observed from this viewpoint - looking straight down from a thousand miles up - you'll see how it dominates the entire hemisphere.
